protocol.title: Isolated disjoint-window OOS replication (ETH-only) of the suggestive EVAL-65 options order-flow toxicity -> forward realized-vol slice (tox/imbalance, bar60, horizon 72), wrapper-free Spearman rank IC

protocol.signal: signal_z_k = expanding-zscore of per-bar options order-flow toxicity (tox) / signed-aggressor imbalance (imbalance), reused verbatim from EVAL-61/EVAL-62 (causal, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target: rv_{k+1..k+H} = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp 1m/5m bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on ETH and at least one of the pre-registered configs (tox::bar60::h72, imbalance::bar60::h72), Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
